summary.en: A line decodes in reading order: each cell flickers through the line's own alphabet and locks left to right; digits never flicker through other digits; Chinese cells flicker through Chinese characters.
summary.zh: 一行字按阅读顺序解码：每个字位在这一行自己的字母里闪动、从左到右锁定；数字不闪过别的数字；中文字位只在汉字里闪。

fits: Every title, claim and result in a phosphor film; any terminal-flavoured title.
notFor: Body text and long lines (the flicker costs reading time); numbers that must read at once.

intent.en: Let a line resolve the way a terminal draws it, so it is read as it locks.
intent.zh: 让一行字像终端那样“解”出来，边锁定边被读到。

content.en: One or two lines of ≤ 4 words.

fits.zh: phosphor 片子里的每个标题、主张和结果；任何带终端味的标题。

notFor.zh: 正文和长句（闪动耗阅读时间）；必须一眼读到的数字。

en: A Chinese line flickering through Latin letters reads as broken text: the pool is Chinese only.
zh: 中文行若闪过拉丁字母，看起来像乱码：字池只用汉字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
